scopeMeaning: One reference installation only; no authorization is conveyed by this plan.
operations: Inspect retained scenario resources and marker-owned Entra API/client pair within the reviewed exact scope.
Repair shared resources with existing azd provision and infrastructure templates after fresh incremental what-if.
Preserve API v2 delegated scope, nine business/floor roles, assignment-required principals and existing object/client IDs.
Append only the actual application HTTPS /auth.html SPA callback to the verified owned client; create no replacement identity.
Verify operator Manager/client assignments and exact Principal access_as_user consent using GET only. Never retry the denied consent write.
Verify installed environment quota for the conservative 28-vCPU rollout.
Build locally, push to the scenario registry, capture immutable digest, install synthetic fixtures and three real Foundry agent versions.
Run output-dependent runtime what-if, deploy web/internal-chat/worker with Entra-only configuration, then conduct separately recorded real acceptance within the same reference grant.
exclusions: No retry of the historical denied consent POST, tenant-wide consent, Graph application permissions or role elevation.
No unrelated users/groups/resources, synthetic staff production fallback, cleanup, teams, composition or publication.
No private endpoints, Search, Storage, real cards, bank settlement, production migration or regional-DR claim.

cost.limitations: Historical planning estimates, not a quote/cap/invoice. Peak compute, overlap, telemetry, storage, egress, taxes and unverified Entra licensing can add cost.
